description: Generate realistic mock data from a JSON Schema. Supports all common types (string, number, integer, boolean, array, object, null), format hints (email, date, date-time, uri, uuid), enum, const, and nested schemas. Perfect for testing MCP tools with realistic data.

count.description: Number of mock objects to generate (default: 1, max: 20)

schema.description: The JSON Schema to generate from — a JSON string, or the schema object itself.

seed.description: Optional seed string for deterministic output (uses first char codes)

name: mock_from_schema
